environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override set to COUNT (not block), (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' with a single RegexPatternSet match condition on the query string component using pattern '(?i)(?:union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|;|--|/\*|\*/|0x[0-9a-f]+|char\(|concat\()' with action BLOCK and priority 0, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action at priority 5. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the VPC endpoint for CloudWatch Logs (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs), enforced by the task's security group which only allows outbound to the VPC endpoint prefix list on port 443 and denies all other egress.

config.ecs_task_security_group_egress: only 443/tcp to com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs VPC endpoint prefix list
